title: Back to School Amid the Delta Variant

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报栏目 DealBook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最有影响力的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、

sentences.en: Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日于 NYTimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用来观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天是。

sentences.en: To safely bring students back to school this fall amid a resurgence of infections, communities across the U.S.
sentences.zh: 为了在今年秋天疫情反弹期间安全地让学生重返学校，美国各地的社区

sentences.en: are planning to mandate masks.
sentences.zh: 正计划强制要求佩戴口罩。

sentences.en: But there's a problem.
sentences.zh: 但这里有个问题。

sentences.en: Several of the country's hardest-hit states have banned such mandates.
sentences.zh: 该国受疫情打击最严重的几个州已经禁止了此类强制令。

sentences.en: Sabrina Tavernisi spoke with our colleague Richard Fawcett about how that conflict is playing out in Arkansas.
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜·塔韦尔西尼与我们的同事理查德·福西特谈论了这一冲突如何在阿肯色州上演。

sentences.en: It's Monday, August 9th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月9日，星期一。

sentences.en: Hi, Richard.
sentences.zh: 嗨，理查德。

sentences.en: Hi, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 嗨，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: How are you doing?
sentences.zh: 你最近怎么样？

sentences.en: Again, remind me, your kids are back at school, right?
sentences.zh: 提醒我一下，你的孩子们是不是又去上学了？

sentences.en: Yeah, my daughter's a senior.
sentences.zh: 对，我女儿上高三了。

sentences.en: She had her first day today.
sentences.zh: 她今天是第一天开学。

sentences.en: But my son, who just started middle school, who started sixth grade and had his third day of school, will be barging into the house in more or less 26 minutes.
sentences.zh: 但我的儿子刚上初中，也就是六年级，今天是他在学校的第三天，他大概再过26分钟就会冲进家里。

sentences.en: So we'll have that to look forward to.
sentences.zh: 所以我们得拭目以待了。

sentences.en: Uh-oh.
sentences.zh: 噢哦。

sentences.en: Okay, let's hurry up.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们快点。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Okay, so it's August, and kids are starting to go back to school, including in your own state of Georgia.
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在是8月，孩子们开始返校了，包括在你自己的家乡佐治亚州。

sentences.en: And I'm kind of remembering last year at this time when we were really pretty confused about the state of schools and what was going to happen with kids.
sentences.zh: 我有点回想起去年这个时候，当时我们对学校的状况以及孩子们会发生什么感到非常困惑。

sentences.en: I mean, you had some places going back, some places not going back.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有些地方复课了，有些地方没有复课。

sentences.en: It was kind of a mess.
sentences.zh: 那一团糟。

sentences.en: And so now we're a year later.
sentences.zh: 现在我们一年后又回到了这里。

sentences.en: Where are we with kids in schools?
sentences.zh: 孩子们在学校的情况怎么样了？

sentences.en: Well, I think you're right.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想你是对的。

sentences.en: I think it was a real mess.
sentences.zh: 我认为那真是一团糟。

sentences.en: As we approached the beginning of the last school year, there were different policies in different school districts.
sentences.zh: 当我们临近上一个学年开学时，不同的学区有不同的政策。

sentences.en: But a lot of school districts opted to tell their students to stay home.
sentences.zh: 但许多学区选择让学生呆在家里。

sentences.en: My own kids stayed home for much, if not all, of the school year last year.
sentences.zh: 去年我的孩子在家待了大部分时间，甚至可以说整个学年都在家。

sentences.en: But I think there's been a consensus as we approach the coming school year that kids really need to be in school.
sentences.zh: 但我认为随着新学年的临近，大家已经达成了一种共识，即孩子们真的需要去学校。

sentences.en: They need to be together.
sentences.zh: 他们需要聚在一起。

sentences.en: They need to be in their seats.
sentences.zh: 他们需要坐在座位上。

sentences.en: They need to be in front of their teachers learning together.
sentences.zh: 他们需要坐在老师面前一起学习。

sentences.en: It's good for socialization.
sentences.zh: 这有利于社交。

sentences.en: It's probably good for just ingesting and processing information.
sentences.zh: 这可能也有利于吸收和处理信息。

sentences.en: But this year, there's this big new concern.
sentences.zh: 但今年，出现了一个重大的新担忧。

sentences.en: The Delta variant is raging through many of our communities.
sentences.zh: 德尔塔变异株正在我们的许多社区肆虐。

sentences.en: And part of the concern is that kids under 12 can't get vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 部分担忧在于12岁以下的儿童无法接种疫苗。

sentences.en: And that's led to this very emotional issue of how exactly we get kids back into school this fall safely.
sentences.zh: 这就引发了一个非常情绪化的议题，即今年秋天我们究竟该如何让孩子们安全返校。

sentences.en: There are a number of places where kids are going to be heading back into schools with a very strict mask mandate.
sentences.zh: 在许多地方，孩子们将在严格的口罩令下重返学校。

sentences.en: Every single child will be back in the classroom.
sentences.zh: 每一个孩子都将回到教室。

sentences.en: New York City is one of these places.
sentences.zh: 纽约市就是其中之一。

sentences.en: I had hoped that a state mask requirement in schools wouldn't be necessary.
sentences.zh: 我曾希望学校不需要出台州级的口罩规定。

sentences.en: The governor of Illinois.
sentences.zh: 伊利诺伊州州长。

sentences.en: But it is.
sentences.zh: 但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: Recently announced that there would be a mask mandate in Illinois' K-12 schools.
sentences.zh: 最近宣布伊利诺伊州的K-12学校将实行口罩强制令。

sentences.en: The Delta variant is highly transmissible, more so than any other previous forms of this virus.
sentences.zh: 德尔塔变异株具有高度传染性，比该病毒以前的任何其他形式都要强。

sentences.en: But in a lot of southern states, you have bans on mask mandates.
sentences.zh: 但在许多南方州，却禁止颁布口罩强制令。

sentences.en: It is ridiculous for a school district to be requiring children to wear the masks unless the parents of those children want them to wear a mask.
sentences.zh: 学区要求儿童佩戴口罩是荒谬的，除非这些孩子的父母希望他们戴口罩。

sentences.en: In South Carolina, the legislature has enacted a mask mandate ban.
sentences.zh: 在南卡罗来纳州，立法机构颁布了口罩令禁令。

sentences.en: This is an issue of parental choice and will not be an issue of mandates.
sentences.zh: 这是一个父母选择的问题，而不是强制令的问题。

sentences.en: And in Texas, Governor Greg Abbott instituted a ban through an executive order in July.
sentences.zh: 在得克萨斯州，州长格雷格·阿博特在7月通过一项行政命令实施了禁令。

sentences.en: There will be no mandates in Texas schools about wearing masks.
sentences.zh: 得克萨斯州的学校不会有任何关于戴口罩的强制令。

sentences.en: And the place where this issue is really blowing up is Florida.
sentences.zh: 而这个问题真正彻底爆发的地方是佛罗里达州。

sentences.en: Why would we have government force masks on our kids?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们要让政府强迫我们的孩子戴口罩？

sentences.en: Where Republican Governor Ron DeSantis has issued an order barring schools from implementing mask mandates.
sentences.zh: 共和党州长罗恩·德桑蒂斯在那里发布了一项行政令，禁止学校实施口罩强制令。

sentences.en: Shouldn't this be something that the parent isn't best to evaluate, the effect that this would have on their children?
sentences.zh: 评估这对他们孩子的影响，难道不应该是父母最擅长的事情吗？

sentences.en: Governor DeSantis, like a lot of Republicans of a certain mind of thinking, is concerned about government overreach.
sentences.zh: 德桑蒂斯州长和许多有某种特定想法的共和党人一样，担心政府权力过大。

sentences.en: My wife and I are not going to do the masks with the kids.
sentences.zh: 我和我妻子不会让孩子们戴口罩。

sentences.en: We never have.
sentences.zh: 我们从来没让他们戴过。

sentences.en: I want to see my kids smiling.
sentences.zh: 我想看到我的孩子们微笑。

sentences.en: I want them having fun.
sentences.zh: 我想让他们玩得开心。

sentences.en: So Governor DeSantis has responded to this kind of rebellion in his midst in a typically two-fisted rhetorical way.
sentences.zh: 因此，德桑蒂斯州长以一种典型的双拳齐出的修辞方式回应了他中间的这种叛乱。

sentences.en: We can either have a free society or we can have a biomedical security state.
sentences.zh: 要么我们拥有一个自由的社会，要么我们拥有一个生物医学安全国家。

sentences.en: And I can tell you, Florida, we're a free state.
sentences.zh: 我可以告诉你，佛罗里达州，我们是一个自由的州。

sentences.en: He's actually threatening now to pull funding from schools that actually enact mask mandates.
sentences.zh: 他现在实际上在威胁要撤回那些真正实施口罩强制令的学校的资金。

sentences.en: And so what are schools doing?
sentences.zh: 那么学校在做什么呢？

sentences.en: Well, the school districts, a number of them are digging in their heels.
sentences.zh: 嗯，许多学区正在坚守阵地。

sentences.en: I need to do what's right to protect the employees and the students.
sentences.zh: 我需要做正确的事来保护员工和学生。

sentences.en: They may end up starting school with a mask mandate.
sentences.zh: 他们最终可能会带着口罩令开学。

sentences.en: If the governor's office pursues action to limit funding for your district, what are you going to do?
sentences.zh: 如果州长办公室采取行动限制你所在学区的资金，你打算怎么办？

sentences.en: We are hoping that this is not the case.
sentences.zh: 我们希望不会出现这种情况。

sentences.en: And it looks like we're headed for a big showdown.
sentences.zh: 看起来我们要迎来一场大对决了。

sentences.en: OK, so we have on one end of the spectrum, basically blue state liberal politicians who are imposing mask mandates.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以在光谱的一端，基本上是实施口罩强制令的蓝州自由派政治家。

sentences.en: And then we have on the other, red state conservative politicians who are resisting them.
sentences.zh: 而在另一端，则是抵制这些强制令的红州保守派政治家。

sentences.en: So is this just sort of a typical red state, blue state divide we've come to expect in the
sentences.zh: 所以这只是我们在美国政治体系中习以为常的典型红州与蓝州的对立吗？

sentences.en: American political system?
sentences.zh: 美国政治体系？

sentences.en: I guess so.
sentences.zh: 我想是的。

sentences.en: But you also have this case that emerged in the last few days of Arkansas, which is a very conservative Republican-leaning state.
sentences.zh: 但过去几天还出现了阿肯色州的案例，这是一个非常保守的倾向共和党的州。

sentences.en: President Trump won the state by 27 points in November.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统在11月以27个百分点的优势赢了该州。

sentences.en: But you have a Republican governor there, a second-term governor, Asa Hutchinson, who really is more of an old-school Reaganite Republican.
sentences.zh: 但你在那里有一位共和党州长，一位连任两届的州长，阿萨·哈utchinson（阿萨·哈钦森），他其实更像是一位老派的里根派共和党人。

sentences.en: But he's dealing with an extremely conservative state legislature.
sentences.zh: 但他正在和一个极端保守的州立法机构打交道。

sentences.en: And toward the end of the first wave of the pandemic, as new cases were going down earlier this year, he made some concessions to that much more conservative wing of his party.
sentences.zh: 在第一波疫情快要结束时，随着今年早些时候新增病例下降，他对党内更加保守的一翼做了一些妥协。

sentences.en: And now he's really running into trouble.
sentences.zh: 现在他真的陷入麻烦了。

sentences.en: And it's coming back to bite him over the issue of the wearing of masks in schools.
sentences.zh: 而且这个问题正在反噬他，起因正是关于在学校戴口罩的问题。

sentences.en: So, Richard, go back to the beginning with the governor.
sentences.zh: 所以，理查德，让我们回到州长刚上台的时候。

sentences.en: How did he manage the pandemic at first?
sentences.zh: 他最初是如何应对这场大流行的？

sentences.en: Well, I think a lot of Arkansans, including a lot of Democrats, would give Governor Hutchinson pretty good marks for his handling of the first phase of this pandemic.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为许多阿肯色州人，包括许多民主党人，会给哈钦森州长在处理这场疫情第一阶段的表现打出相当高的分数。

sentences.en: I have listened to doctors and nurses who were on the front line in this fight against
sentences.zh: 我听取了在这场抗击新冠肺炎疫情最前线的医生和护士的意见，

sentences.en: COVID-19, and they asked the public to do more.
sentences.zh: 他们要求公众做得更多。

sentences.en: He was trying, like many governors, to balance concerns about public health with the need to keep the economy open.
sentences.zh: 像许多州长一样，他试图在对公共健康的关切与保持经济开放的需求之间取得平衡。

sentences.en: Early in 2020, he ordered the shutdown of gyms, dining rooms, and bars.
sentences.zh: 在2020年初，他下令关闭了健身房、餐厅和酒吧。

sentences.en: And by July...
sentences.zh: 到了7月……

sentences.en: I do want to announce today that I am issuing a statewide mandate for face coverings.
sentences.zh: 我今天确实要宣布，我正在发布一项全州范围的面部遮盖物强制令。

sentences.en: He put in place a statewide mask mandate on the theory that this would actually help businesses stay open safely.
sentences.zh: 他颁布了一项全州范围的口罩令，其理论是这实际上有助于企业安全营业。

sentences.en: I believe this mandate is appropriate and necessary.
sentences.zh: 我相信这一强制令是恰当且必要的。

sentences.en: I think there's a lot of support for the governor when he issued his mask mandate across party lines.
sentences.zh: 我认为当州长跨党派发布口罩令时，得到了很多支持。

sentences.en: But there are also certainly some prominent conservatives who were concerned about it.
sentences.zh: 但也确实有一些对此感到担忧的知名保守派人士。

sentences.en: But the governor kept the mask mandate through the winter and didn't rescind it until March, when the numbers started really plummeting, at least for a while.
sentences.zh: 但州长整个冬天都维持着口罩令，直到3月份数字开始真正骤降时才废除，至少持续了一段时间。

sentences.en: And so by the criteria that we set, it's an appropriate time to lift the statewide mask mandate.
sentences.zh: 因此，根据我们设定的标准，现在是解除全州口罩令的适当时机。

sentences.en: But there was still a problem, and that's that a number of conservatives, particularly conservatives in the state legislature, were really worried about any future impingement
sentences.zh: 但仍然存在一个问题，那就是许多保守派，尤其是州立法机构中的保守派，在经历了这段非常艰难的时期后，非常担心未来对个人自由的侵犯。

sentences.en: on personal liberty after having gone through this very difficult period.
sentences.zh: 在经历了这段非常艰难的时期之后。

sentences.en: And so in April, the governor found himself with a bill on his desk that he ended up signing.
sentences.zh: 所以在4月份，州长发现桌上放着一项他最终签署的法案。

sentences.en: And this law ended up banning any kind of mask mandates in most government entities.
sentences.zh: 这项法律最终禁止了大多数政府实体中的任何形式的口罩强制令。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So here's this Republican legislature.
sentences.zh: 所以这里有这个共和党立法机构。

sentences.en: It's saying basically, scrapping the mandate isn't good enough for us.
sentences.zh: 它基本上是说，取消强制令对我们来说还不够。

sentences.en: We want to prevent the governor and anyone else from ever issuing another one.
sentences.zh: 我们想要阻止州长和其他任何人再发布任何其他强制令。

sentences.en: And Hutchinson, a guy who's actually been pretty non-ideological about masks all along, he signs it, essentially tying his own hands for the future.
sentences.zh: 而哈钦森，一个一直以来对口罩相当不带意识形态色彩的人，却签署了它，基本上在未来绑住了自己的手。

sentences.en: Why would he do that?
sentences.zh: 他为什么要这么做？

sentences.en: It's a good question.
sentences.zh: 这是个好问题。

sentences.en: And some observers, including some Democrats, feel like he may have been trying to navigate the politics of this state, even though Asa Hutchinson can't run for re-election.
sentences.zh: 一些观察人士，包括一些民主党人，觉得他可能一直在试图驾驭该州的政治局势，尽管阿萨·哈钦森不能竞选连任。

sentences.en: He's a very popular politician in Arkansas.
sentences.zh: 他是阿肯色州非常受欢迎的政治家。

sentences.en: He's been around public life for many decades.
sentences.zh: 他在公众生活中已经活跃了几十年。

sentences.en: He's a very smart guy.
sentences.zh: 他是一个非常聪明的人。

sentences.en: And a lot of people think that he may be eyeing higher office and that perhaps this was a way to kind of find a way to placate the more Trumpian, hard-right elements that are part
sentences.zh: 许多人认为他可能在盯着更高阶的职位，这或许是一种方式，用以安抚那些作为阿肯色州共和党基本盘组成部分的、更加特朗普式的极右翼分子。

sentences.en: of the Republican base in Arkansas.
sentences.zh: 共和党基本盘的一部分。

sentences.en: But he also has said that it looked like this crisis was over and it was a real gamble because you had to sort of hope that the pandemic wouldn't come roaring back.
sentences.zh: 但他也曾表示，当时这场危机看起来已经结束了，这是一场真正的赌博，因为你只能希望大流行不会卷土重来。

sentences.en: And that's exactly what it did a few months later.
sentences.zh: 而几个月后，情况恰恰如此。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一个专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like
sentences.zh: 甚至在黑胶唱片时代的夜总会里当DJ时，你每天晚上也要带着300件你最珍爱的传家宝去上班，你把一个DJ台变成了一个像

sentences.en: living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.

sentences.en: Richard, what happens when the Delta variant starts surging in Arkansas?
sentences.zh: 理查德，当德尔塔变异株开始在阿肯色州激增时，会发生什么？

sentences.en: So Arkansas, like most states, saw this really nice trough with very low numbers of new cases that went from the spring in toward the early summer.
sentences.zh: 所以阿肯色州和大多数州一样，经历了这样一个美好的低谷，从春季到初夏，新增病例数非常低。

sentences.en: The whole idea of wearing a mask starts to fade into the background and life starts to kind of return to normal.
sentences.zh: 戴口罩的想法开始淡出人们的视线，生活也开始恢复正常。

sentences.en: But then Delta hits in the summertime and you started to see a lot of the concerns around personal freedom and personal liberty that had made some people wary of wearing a mask
sentences.zh: 但随后德尔塔在夏天袭击了这里，你开始看到许多围绕个人自由的担忧，这些担忧曾使一些人对戴口罩感到警惕。

sentences.en: now surface when it came to the question of vaccines.
sentences.zh: 现在来看疫苗的问题。

sentences.en: And this vaccine hesitancy became a real concern for Governor Hutchinson, who rightly sees the vaccine as the key to bringing the number of cases down in his state.
sentences.zh: 这种对疫苗的犹豫让哈钦森州长感到非常担忧，他正确地将疫苗视为降低该州病例数的关键。

sentences.en: So he launched on this barnstorming tour of a number of communities around the state.
sentences.zh: 因此，他在该州的许多社区展开了一场旋风般的巡回演讲。

sentences.en: I am so thrilled to be here.
sentences.zh: 我非常高兴能来到这里。

sentences.en: And this is an incredible crowd that's here at a very awkward...
sentences.zh: 这是一个令人难以置信的人群，在一个非常尴尬的...

sentences.en: where he took the case personally to people, including many skeptics, arguing to them that they really needed to get a shot in the arm to get over this next wave.
sentences.zh: 他亲自向人们阐述观点，其中包括许多怀疑论者，向他们论证他们真的需要接种疫苗以度过这下一波疫情。

sentences.en: We want to hear from everybody, but let's make a few comments and we'll turn it open for discussion.
sentences.zh: 我们想听取大家的意见，但让我们先发表几点评论，然后开放讨论。

sentences.en: But I also want to put this in perspective in terms of COVID.
sentences.zh: 但我也想从新冠疫情的角度来看待这个问题。

sentences.en: So the governor's goal was to really try to beat back a ton of misinformation that's out there and a ton of anger and a ton of fear.
sentences.zh: 因此，州长的目标其实是试图击退泛滥的虚假信息、愤怒和恐惧。

sentences.en: And it's really been this kind of remarkable effort to get out in front of people and try to sort of vaccinate them against misinformation.
sentences.zh: 这确实是一种非常了不起的努力，走出去面对公众，试图为他们接种对抗虚假信息的“疫苗”。

sentences.en: We simply ask people to talk to your trusted advisor.
sentences.zh: 我们只是要求人们与你信任的顾问交谈。

sentences.en: It sounds like that you have.
sentences.zh: 听起来你已经这么做了。

sentences.en: And you make a decision for your child.
sentences.zh: 而你为你的孩子做出决定。

sentences.en: It sounds like he's trying to prevent vaccines from becoming the new masks.
sentences.zh: 听起来他正试图阻止疫苗成为新的口罩。

sentences.en: In other words, he's trying to keep this issue from becoming the next political lightning rod.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，他正试图阻止这个问题成为下一个政治引爆点。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: But as the governor is bombing around the state with this message, there were people all over who were receptive to the message.
sentences.zh: 但正当州长带着这个信息在全州奔走时，到处都有人对这个信息持接受态度。

sentences.en: But he was certainly also getting a lot of vocal pushback in a number of places.
sentences.zh: 不过他在很多地方无疑也遇到了很多激烈的反对声浪。

sentences.en: It's just simply your choice.
sentences.zh: 这完全是你的选择。

sentences.en: But I also have to address it from a public health standpoint as a state, knowing that we're going to be living with people dying if we do not increase our vaccination rates.
sentences.zh: 但作为一州之长，从公共卫生的角度来看，我也必须解决这个问题，因为我们知道，如果我们不提高疫苗接种率，就会眼睁睁看着人们死去。

sentences.en: So I still need to get that message.
sentences.zh: 所以我仍然需要传达这个信息。

sentences.en: It's just frankly, a lot of people who are just working off of misinformation.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，很多人只是根据虚假信息行事。

sentences.en: And it's a very scary situation.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常可怕的局面。

sentences.en: So ma'am, ma'am, ma'am.
sentences.zh: 所以，女士，女士，女士。

sentences.en: No, no, no, don't give her the mic.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不，不要把麦克风给她。

sentences.en: People were calling him a liar.
sentences.zh: 人们称他为骗子。

sentences.en: All right, so let's identify.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那么我们来确认一下。

sentences.en: Would you all like to be...
sentences.zh: 你们大家愿意...

sentences.en: There were a lot of signs and a lot of shouting from people who were very skeptical about vaccines and very concerned about more government regulations.
sentences.zh: 有许多标语，也有很多来自对疫苗非常怀疑、对更多政府监管非常担忧的人的呐喊。

sentences.en: So we'd like to have people have an opportunity to say something, but also for us to be able to respond.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们希望让人们有机会说出自己的想法，同时也让我们能够作出回应。

sentences.en: And I think Governor Hutchinson would argue that not only did he try to keep his presentation
sentences.zh: 我想哈钦森州长会认为，他不仅试图让自己的演讲

sentences.en: to such people based in the science, but that he also tried to approach them with a certain
sentences.zh: 建立在科学基础之上，而且他还试图以某种

sentences.en: sense of respect, a respect for their skepticism, in an effort to really bring a kind of evidence-based and less hot-under-the-collar response.
sentences.zh: 尊重态度对待他们——尊重他们的怀疑，努力提供一种基于证据且不那么情绪化的回应。

sentences.en: All right, so y'all, I appreciate everybody that's expressed themselves.
sentences.zh: 好吧，各位，我感谢所有表达了自己意见的人。

sentences.en: I think very clearly we got about every viewpoint that's been expressed.
sentences.zh: 我认为很明显，我们听到了几乎所有的观点。

sentences.en: So the governor's going around the state, and particularly recently, we've seen some of the vaccination numbers go up in the state, but it's still lagging compared to a lot of
sentences.zh: 因此，州长正在全州奔走，尤其是最近，我们看到该州的疫苗接种数字有所上升，但与许多

sentences.en: states.
sentences.zh: 州相比，仍然滞后。

sentences.en: And in the meantime, the beginning of school is looming, ever larger.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，开学日也越来越近了。

sentences.en: So on the one hand, you have kids under 12 who can't get vaccinated, who are about to be back in the classroom, and you also have this large number of adults who are holding
sentences.zh: 一方面，你有12岁以下无法接种疫苗、即将重返课堂的孩子，另一方面，你还有大量

sentences.en: out on getting vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 对接种疫苗持观望态度的成年人。

sentences.en: And it kind of rolls into this big ball of concern about how kids are actually going to be able to go back to school safely.
sentences.zh: 这汇聚成了一个巨大的担忧，即孩子们究竟将如何安全地重返学校。

sentences.en: And it's that concern that really brought the question of masks in school back to the forefront of the conversation in Arkansas.
sentences.zh: 正是这种担忧，真正将学校口罩问题重新推到了阿肯色州对话的最前沿。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so what are schools saying about this as this first day back approaches?
sentences.zh: 那么随着开学第一天的临近，学校对此是怎么说的呢？

sentences.en: Well, you've had a number of school districts that have been very concerned to the point where they've pleaded with the governor and with the legislature to let them go ahead
sentences.zh: 嗯，有很多学区非常担忧，甚至向州长和立法机关恳求，让他们继续

sentences.en: and put a mask mandate in place, particularly as the numbers continue to look quite bad.
sentences.zh: 实施口罩令，特别是在疫情数据继续看起来相当糟糕的情况下。

sentences.en: Last week, I talked to the superintendent of the Little Rock School District and has, I think, 20,000-something students.
sentences.zh: 上周，我采访了小石城学区的总监，那里大概有两万多名学生。

sentences.en: We've been in a planning mode, in some ways, for 18 months.

sentences.en: You know, it has been nonstop.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是没完没了的。

sentences.en: And he essentially told me that a huge part of his job was to broadly ensure that the children in his care were safe and remain safe.
sentences.zh: 他基本上告诉我，他的工作很大一部分是广泛确保他照料下的儿童的安全并保持安全。

sentences.en: When you have this many people that have not got a vaccine, adults and kids in particular, and under 12 can't even have a vaccine, that you've got to put every tool in your belt
sentences.zh: 当你遇到这么多没有接种疫苗的人，特别是成年人和孩子，而且12岁以下甚至不能接种疫苗时，你必须用尽浑身解数

sentences.en: to try to create a protective environment.
sentences.zh: 来试图创造一个保护性的环境。

sentences.en: And in his opinion, this meant having the freedom to enact a mask mandate for his kids and for his staff.
sentences.zh: 在他看来，这意味着有自由为他的孩子和员工颁布口罩令。

sentences.en: But of course, he can't actually do that because there's a law against the mask mandates that
sentences.zh: 但当然，他实际上无法做到这一点，因为有一项反对口罩令的法律

sentences.zh: 是由哈钦森州长签署的。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, Governor Hutchinson, feeling the pressure from some superintendents and some school boards

sentences.en: and some school officials who really wanted to put a mask mandate in place, announced that he was going to convene a special session of the legislature in an effort to get them to
sentences.zh: 和一些真正希望实施口罩令的学校官员的压力，宣布他将召集立法机关举行特别会议，以争取让他们

sentences.en: create a kind of legal carve-out to the mask mandate ban.
sentences.zh: 为口罩令禁令制定某种法律豁免条款。

sentences.en: But it would only apply to school districts.
sentences.zh: 但这只适用于学区。

sentences.en: But making this plan happen so far has been a pretty difficult proposition.
sentences.zh: 但到目前为止，要实现这个计划一直是一个相当困难的提议。

sentences.en: And I think one of the purest manifestations of the opposition to that kind of idea was one that I really stumbled upon when I flew to Arkansas last week.
sentences.zh: 我认为对这种想法的反对的最纯粹体现之一，就是我上周飞往阿肯色州时偶然发现的。

sentences.en: I got in a car and drove straight to the state capitol in downtown Little Rock to try to set up some meetings.
sentences.zh: 我上车直接开往小石城市中心的州议会大厦，试图安排一些会面。

sentences.en: But before I even walked in the building, I realized that I was in the midst of
sentences.zh: 但甚至在我走进大楼之前，我就意识到我身处

sentences.en: Good morning, everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家早上好。

sentences.en: Thanks for being here.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们来到这里。

sentences.en: An anti-mask mandate and, to a large degree, anti-vaccination rally on the steps of the state capitol.
sentences.zh: 一场在州议会大厦台阶上举行反对口罩令、并在很大程度上反对疫苗接种的集会中。

sentences.en: We just need to quit being the silent majority.
sentences.zh: 我们只需要停止做沉默的大多数。

sentences.en: There were about 80 people there.
sentences.zh: 那里大约有80人。

sentences.en: The feeling felt a bit like a Trump rally.
sentences.zh: 这种感觉有点像特朗普的集会。

sentences.en: There was a lot of Trump paraphernalia, a lot of Don't Tread on Me Gadsden flags, a lot of American flags.
sentences.zh: 有很多特朗普的行头，很多“不要踏在我身上”的加兹登旗，还有很多美国国旗。

sentences.en: It was an all-white crowd.
sentences.zh: 这是一群全白人的人群。

sentences.en: Let's let them hear it inside.
sentences.zh: 让我们让他们在里面听到。

sentences.en: Let's get loud.
sentences.zh: 大声喊出来。

sentences.en: And it was a very impassioned affair.
sentences.zh: 这是一场非常激昂的活动。

sentences.en: A number of people spoke out against the mask mandate.
sentences.zh: 许多人公开反对口罩令。

sentences.en: They spoke out against Governor Hutchinson.
sentences.zh: 他们公开反对哈钦森州长。

sentences.en: We're not masking our kids again.
sentences.zh: 我们不会再给我们的孩子戴口罩了。

sentences.en: I want to hear it.
sentences.zh: 我想听到你们的声音。

sentences.en: We are not masking our kids again.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不会再给我们的孩子戴口罩了。

sentences.en: Do not comply.
sentences.zh: 不要服从。

sentences.en: Absolutely do not comply.
sentences.zh: 绝对不要服从。

sentences.en: Because if you follow the news, the mainstream media in the United States, you're being lied to.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你关注新闻，即美国的 )}$ 主流媒体，你就在被欺骗。

sentences.en: Kind of laying out this argument that the ban on the mask mandates needed to stand.
sentences.zh: 基本上阐述了这样一个论点：口罩令的禁令必须维持。

sentences.en: Stand firm for 10-0-0-2.
sentences.zh: 坚定支持10002号法案。

sentences.zh: 坚定支持10002号法案。

sentences.en: Stand firm for 10-0-0-2.
sentences.zh: 坚定支持10002号法案。

sentences.en: Stand firm.
sentences.zh: 立场坚定。

sentences.en: At one point, one of the adult speakers asked if there were any students and children who wanted to come up and speak.
sentences.zh: 有一次，其中一位成年发言者问是否有任何学生和儿童想上台发言。

sentences.en: I don't want to put you on the spot, but I want to see if any of the kids would like to say anything.
sentences.zh: 我不想当众点名，但我看看是否有任何孩子想说点什么。

sentences.en: This is what they're voting on is affecting you more than it is us.
sentences.zh: 他们正在投票表决的事情对你的影响比对我们的影响更大。

sentences.en: Hey, we do have one brave kid that's wanting to come up here.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我们确实有一个勇敢的孩子想要到这里来。

sentences.en: Her name's Samantha.
sentences.zh: 她叫萨曼莎。

sentences.en: So what you're describing is pretty intense, pretty emotional, right?
sentences.zh: 所以你所描述的相当激烈，相当情绪化，对吧？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So even this little carve-out, even that is too charged right now.
sentences.zh: 所以即使是这个小小的豁免，甚至这也太敏感了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And, you know, that's a real reflection, I think, of where a lot of the energy is in the Republican Party in a state like Arkansas.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为这真实反映了阿肯色州这样的州里共和党内许多能量的所在。

sentences.en: Where you have this extremely emotional response to issues like mask mandates, which, you know,
sentences.zh: 在这里，你对口罩令之类的问题有着这种极其情绪化的反应，你知道的，

sentences.en: I think public health officials would like to see discussed with a minimum of emotion.

sentences.en: And yet it's the energy that's emanating off of this issue among the grassroots that is reflected in these very conservative legislatures and even affecting legislators who aren't super far to the right,

sentences.en: So going back to the beginning, Richard, it kind of feels like that gamble that you were talking about,

sentences.en: the political calculation that Hutchinson made in signing the ban on mask mandates, is kind of coming back to bite him.

sentences.en: Yeah, I think so.

sentences.en: Thank you for joining me for today's update.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收看今天的最新报道。

sentences.en: I'm glad to have...
sentences.zh: 我很高兴有...

sentences.en: You know, I asked him about this at a news conference, and he said that he regretted it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我在一次新闻发布会上问过他这个问题，他说他对此感到后悔。

sentences.en: Yes, in hindsight, I wish that had not become law, but it is the law,

sentences.en: And so last week...

sentences.en: I also wanted to mention...

sentences.en: I sat down with Governor Hutchinson in his office, and he was happy to talk about where things had been and where things were going.
sentences.zh: 我在办公室里坐下来采访了哈钦森州长，他很高兴谈论过去的情况以及未来的走向。

sentences.en: I think the entire debate and controversies over masks is very, very unfortunate and has made it difficult, certainly, for people to follow medical science and to have trust in it,
sentences.zh: 我认为围绕口罩的整个辩论和争议是非常非常不幸的，这无疑使人们很难遵循医学科学并在其中建立信任，

sentences.en: which we ordinarily do in our country.
sentences.zh: 而我们在我们国家通常是这样做的。

sentences.en: So in my conversation with the governor, I asked if he was worried that the signing of the bill in April may have hardened distrust about the overall culture of mask wearing.
sentences.zh: 因此，在我与州长的交谈中，我问他是否担心在4月份签署该法案可能会加剧对戴口罩整体文化的深度不信任。

sentences.en: Did you worry that the signing of the bill would so distrust just about the culture of mask wearing and that sort of thing?
sentences.zh: 你是否担心签署该法案会如此引发对戴口罩文化及其之类的不信任？

sentences.en: You're saying that Act 1002 reinforced the skepticism of people about masks?
sentences.zh: 你是说10002号法案加深了人们对口罩的怀疑？

sentences.en: I think they already...
sentences.zh: 我想他们已经……

sentences.en: Perhaps.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: I mean, that could be fair.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这倒也公允。

sentences.en: And he said that it very well may have.
sentences.zh: 他说这非常有可能。

sentences.en: It took tools away from the executive branch in managing the public health crisis, but it locked it in.
sentences.zh: 它剥夺了行政部门在管理公共卫生危机时的工具，但它将其固定化了。

sentences.en: So, Richard, it sounds like what he's saying to you in this interview is he's a little bit stuck.
sentences.zh: 所以，理查德，听起来他在这次采访中对你说的是他有点进退维谷。

sentences.en: I mean, what can he do if masks are kind of a lost cause?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果口罩已经近乎无可挽回，他能做什么呢？

sentences.en: Well, that's a really good question.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这真的是个好问题。

sentences.en: In some ways, the governor got what he wanted, but not exactly in the way he thought he would.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，州长得到了他想要的，但并不完全是他想象中的那种方式。

sentences.en: On Friday, a judge in Little Rock issued an injunction to temporarily block the entire mask mandate ban.
sentences.zh: 周五，小石城的一名法官发布了一项禁令，暂时阻止了整个口罩令禁令。

sentences.en: And this came just almost minutes after the state legislature met in their special session and declined to take up what was essentially his amendment to the law.
sentences.zh: 而就在州议会举行特别会议并拒绝采纳他的那项法律修正案后几乎几分钟，这个消息就传出来了。

sentences.en: But there's still a lot up in the air.
sentences.zh: 但仍有许多事情悬而未决。

sentences.en: These issues may now have to be fought district to district.
sentences.zh: 这些问题现在可能不得不在各个学区之间进行抗争。

sentences.en: And the governor now, I think, thinks that he's going to have to really focus on the issue that he thinks he can get some traction on, which is the question of vaccines.
sentences.zh: 而州长现在，我认为，觉得他必须真正专注于他认为能够取得进展的问题，也就是疫苗问题。

sentences.en: And in fact, he said he's going to go back out on the trail and keep going to the people and trying to make the case in person that they get a shot in the arm.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他说他将重返巡回宣讲，继续走向民众，当面阐述他们应该接种疫苗的理由。

sentences.en: What's important is that whenever you have these town hall meetings, no one is shamed.
sentences.zh: 重要的是，无论什么时候举行这些市政厅会议，都没有人会被羞辱。

sentences.en: They want to have honest conversations.
sentences.zh: 他们希望进行坦诚的对话。

sentences.en: You have to treat skepticism with respect, which I do, and having trusted people that respond to it.
sentences.zh: 你必须带着尊重对待怀疑论，我是这么做的，并且有值得信赖的人来回应它。

sentences.en: That's resulted in yesterday 30,000 vaccinations in Arkansas.
sentences.zh: 这导致昨天阿肯色州有30,000人接种了疫苗。

sentences.en: So I see a lot of hope in what we're doing.
sentences.zh: 所以我从我们正在做的事情中看到了很多希望。

sentences.en: And regardless of what the legislature does, we're going to increase those vaccinations and we're going to work through this.
sentences.zh: 无论立法机关做什么，我们都将增加这些疫苗接种，并挺过难关。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: Very helpful.
sentences.zh: 非常有帮助。

sentences.en: Let me turn this off.
sentences.zh: 我把这个关掉。

sentences.en: So I think the big concern in Arkansas and beyond is whether or not these fights over mask mandates are going to continue.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得阿肯色州及其他地区最关心的，是关于口罩强制令的争论是否会持续下去。

sentences.en: And what that might mean for the warp and the rhythm of the coming school year.
sentences.zh: 以及这可能对即将到来的学年的节奏和秩序意味着什么。

sentences.en: I had a conversation with the superintendent of the Marion, Arkansas School District, which starts its school year quite early, in late July.
sentences.zh: 我与阿肯色州马里昂学区的总 superintendent 进行了一次交谈，他们的学区开学很早，在七月下旬。

sentences.en: And after the first few days, they found 10 positive coronavirus cases in their schools and they had to subsequently quarantine 168 people.
sentences.zh: 在最初几天之后，他们在学校里发现了10例新冠阳性病例，随后不得不隔离了168人。

sentences.en: And I think if masks continue to be this big fight,
sentences.zh: 我想如果戴口罩继续成为这样一场巨大的争论，

sentences.en: it's going to raise a lot of questions and a lot of fears for parents and for educators about exactly how this coming school year is going to go.
sentences.zh: 这将会引发家长和教育工作者对即将到来的学年究竟会如何发展的许多疑问和恐惧。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So the stakes feel pretty high.
sentences.zh: 所以这让人感到风险相当高。

sentences.en: I mean, kids might have another lost year of school.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，孩子们可能会再失去一年的学业。

sentences.en: I think that's the possibility that that has everyone on edge right now.
sentences.zh: 我认为这种可能性让现在每个人都感到紧张不安。

sentences.en: Thank you, Richard.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，理查德。

sentences.en: Thanks, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: Nice talking to you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴和您交谈。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: On Sunday, the Taliban seized two of Afghanistan's regional capitals, including the strategically important city of Kondus.
sentences.zh: 周日，塔利班夺取了阿富汗的两个地区首府，其中包括具有战略重要性的昆都士市。

sentences.en: Over the past week, four regional capitals have fallen to the Taliban.
sentences.zh: 在过去的一周里，已有四个地区首府落入塔利班手中。

sentences.en: The successful attacks highlight the risk of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这些成功的袭击突显了美军撤出阿富汗的风险，

sentences.en: military withdrawal from Afghanistan, which is scheduled to be completed next month.
sentences.zh: 美军撤离计划于下个月完成。

sentences.en: And on Sunday night, the 32nd Summer Olympics came to a close much as they began, with an elaborate ceremony held in a stadium without a crowd because of COVID-19 restrictions.
sentences.zh: 周日晚间，第三十二届夏季奥林匹克运动会闭幕了，就像开幕时一样，由于新冠疫情防控限制，闭幕式在一个没有观众的体育场举行，场面盛大。

sentences.en: Overall, the United States won the most medals, taking home more than 100, and just barely won the most gold medals, edging out China by a single medal.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，美国获得了最多的奖牌，带回了100多枚，并且以微弱优势赢得了最多的金牌，仅比中国多出一枚奖牌。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Rob Sipko and Eric Krupke, with help from Annie Brown.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由罗布·西普科和埃里克·克鲁普克制作，安妮·布朗提供了帮助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Paige Coward, contains original music by Dan Powell, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 节目由佩奇·考德编辑，包含丹·鲍威尔的原创音乐，并由克里斯·伍德进行工程制作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《纽约时报头条新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Willbarro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·威尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当选举迎来了群自称是改革派的人时。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱、有时又令人兴奋的争斗之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都市》节目中，由我萨拉·凯尼格主持，讲述了人们试图保持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在您获取播客的任何地方收听。
